questions.prompt: When does the goal driver send the next round?
options: Every 60 seconds while the goal is active
When the agent becomes idle, the goal is active and no other prompt waits
After every step of a turn
Only when a person types continue
questions.explanation: The driver reacts to the idle status. It checks the goal and the inbox, so it never interrupts a turn or a person's message.

questions.prompt: A goal has maxGoalRounds 3 and 3 rounds have started without success. What does the driver do at the next idle moment?
options: It marks the goal blocked with round-limit
questions.explanation: roundsStarted equals the cap, so the driver blocks the goal instead of sending another round.

questions.prompt: Why does only the model mark a goal complete, and not the driver?
options: The driver cannot read session events
The driver only sees status and rounds; judging the work needs the model to check the evidence
Completion must be approved by a subagent
The cap marks every goal complete
questions.explanation: The driver knows when the agent is idle, not whether the objective is met. The model checks the evidence and calls update_goal.
